Data:Acted.aladim.hunt.changing.scale.js.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.hunt.changing.scale.js.desc: The Aleppine came to believe that Abecassis had accepted gifts of sustenance from 'she who suckles serpents.'

Data:Acted.aladim.lost.find.rose.json.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.lost.find.rose.json.desc: At the behest of his patron the Vagabond, the Aleppine set out to find the piebald garden in the wastes... but his heart was troubled within him.

Data:Acted.aladim.observe.scaly.scale.js.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.observe.scaly.scale.js.desc: The Aleppine resolved that the Cross-business in the clouds above St Tentreto was worthy of his attention.

Data:Acted.aladim.omen.horizon.rose.json.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.omen.horizon.rose.json.desc: The Aleppine suspected that Hendrik Dewulf had been no ordinary mercenary captain... and that a connection between Brancrug and Ys meant he might begin a journey to Ys here, on the Isle.

Data:Acted.aladim.rising.scale.json.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.rising.scale.json.desc: The Aleppine, suspecting some connection between the Seven-Coils and the Sun, fearing what he might find if he visited the Oracle of the Rising While... chose not to go.

Data:Acted.aladim.rite.awakening.scale.j.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.rite.awakening.scale.j.desc: The Aleppine declared his intention to commit the sandalwood image to the flames, for fear that the deacon might 'begin to buzz'.

Data:Acted.aladim.stalk.rose.json.label: Acted: al-Adim
Data:Acted.aladim.stalk.rose.json.desc: The Aleppine could not determine the best answer for Medusa's Riddle, 'What Is Not Seen?' He suggested wryly that the answer should be he himself.

Data:Acted.arthur.hunt.changing.edge.jso.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.hunt.changing.edge.jso.desc: Lieutenant Moore resolved to take Abecassis into the custody of the Labyrinth of Lions.

Data:Acted.arthur.mob.edge.json.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.mob.edge.json.desc: Lieutenant Moore found the weapon he needed to put down Reckoners in Kaunas.

Data:Acted.arthur.mystical.lantern.json.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.mystical.lantern.json.desc: Lieutenant Moore dared to hope that he might begin to understand 'the Sun's Plan'.

Data:Acted.arthur.omen.dawn.lantern.json.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.omen.dawn.lantern.json.desc: Lieutenant Moore came to believe that the miracles in Messana might mean the Second Dawn was near. 'When the world changes,' he observed, 'it will change all at once.'

Data:Acted.arthur.project.solar.lantern..label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.project.solar.lantern..desc: Lieutenant Moore was concerned about his great-nephew's part in the Royal Endeavour - but a visit to Hush House soothed those concerns.

Data:Acted.arthur.revolution.edge.json.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.revolution.edge.json.desc: Lieutenant Moore sympathised with the rebels in the Bounds... but his concerns about their honesty weighed heavily on him.

Data:Acted.arthur.stalk.edge.json.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
Data:Acted.arthur.stalk.edge.json.desc: Lieutentant Moore, preparing himself to face Medusa, came to fear that the answer to her riddle - 'What Is Not Seen?' - was not 'Light', as he had long believed.

Data:Acted.arun.box.moon.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.box.moon.json.desc: Dr Peel, confident that the occupant of St Mihail's Coffin would escape soon, was equally confident that someone, or something, would be eaten by something, or someone. He seemed quite chipper about it.

Data:Acted.arun.lost.find.moth.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.lost.find.moth.json.desc: Dr Peel, as so often, found what he sought at Brancrug, delivered himself of a riddle, and departed, his intentions still obscure.

Data:Acted.arun.mob.moon.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.mob.moon.json.desc: Dr Peel went off to Kaunas to collect knives, or sow confusion, or bring peace. Or something.

Data:Acted.arun.opera.wings.moth.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.opera.wings.moth.json.desc: Dr Peel hoped for 'a chat' with Ferezeref the Magpie, Name of the Moth, who he held responsible for the opera's disasters.

Data:Acted.arun.rising.moon.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.rising.moon.json.desc: Dr Peel propounded an obscure theory about a sacrament of blood which might be shared with the Sun at dusk and at dawn; and exited stage left.

Data:Acted.arun.rite.renewal.moon.json.label: Acted: Peel
Data:Acted.arun.rite.renewal.moon.json.desc: Dr Peel went off to watch the rite at Gladwyn Lake, intoning sinister names: Robigo the Generous with Hosts; the Crowned Growth; Ortucchio...

Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.moon.a.moon.js.label: Acted: Aunt M
Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.moon.a.moon.js.desc: 'Yes, dear. If we don't know what we've lost when we've buried it, we won't know it until they've buried us. I would think about what I'm ready to bury, if I were you. Sleep softly.'

Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.moon.b.moon.js.label: Acted: Aunt M
Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.moon.b.moon.js.desc: 'Yes, dear. Without all those gods in darkness, I don't imagine we'd see much Sun anywhere below Eternity. Sleep softly.'

Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.wood.nectar.js.label: Acted: Aunt M
Data:Acted.auntmopsy.numa.wood.nectar.js.desc: 'Yes, dear. No paper without trees; no forest without the axe; no loss without memory. Sleep softly.'

Data:Acted.azita.hunt.changing.edge.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.hunt.changing.edge.json.desc: The Edge-long Azita's eternal enemy-twin, Mehrad, planned to give Abecassis death with honour. With regret, Azita set out to prevent this.

Data:Acted.azita.mob.edge.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.mob.edge.json.desc: Azita went to Kaunas to, she claimed, knock Reckoners' heads together.

Data:Acted.azita.observe.scaly.sky.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.observe.scaly.sky.json.desc: The Edge-long Azita came to believe that her enemy-twin Mehrad was one of those in whom the Cross-nature endured; and she followed him West.

Data:Acted.azita.opera.apollo.sky.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.opera.apollo.sky.json.desc: Azita wanted to ensure that the production got every detail right - to make it the best possible bait for her 'dearest enemy' Mehrad.

Data:Acted.azita.project.ingenious.sky.j.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.project.ingenious.sky.j.desc: Azita believed Zidane had been murdered - and, after investigating possible motives, speculated that he had 'been eavesdropping at the keyholes of heaven.'

Data:Acted.azita.revolution.edge.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.revolution.edge.json.desc: Azita found an 'acceptable substitute' for the taenite knives that the Légion du Seuil needed.

Data:Acted.azita.stalk.edge.json.label: Acted: Azita
Data:Acted.azita.stalk.edge.json.desc: Azita set off to play her 'silly games' with her enemy-twin Mehrad in Budapest... competing to cut a scrap from the robe of Medusa herself.

Data:Acted.chaima.hunt.changing.edge.jso.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.hunt.changing.edge.jso.desc: Lalla Chaima set out to end Abecassis' misery... although her ultimate intention remained uncertain, even to her.

Data:Acted.chaima.lost.find.rose.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.lost.find.rose.json.desc: Lalla Chaima undertook a commission for the Bureau in Miah - whether to find the piebald garden, or conceal it, was never clear.

Data:Acted.chaima.mob.edge.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.mob.edge.json.desc: Lalla Chaima set off, without enthusiasm, to complete a commission for a Reckoner lord in the sewers of Kaunas.

Data:Acted.chaima.omen.horizon.rose.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.omen.horizon.rose.json.desc: Lalla Chaima set out to hunt the emissaries of Ys on the Bureau's commmission - though even with what she had learnt at Brancrug, she did not expect to find them.

Data:Acted.chaima.revolution.edge.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.revolution.edge.json.desc: Lalla Chaima, armed with what she had learnt at Hush House, set off to offer battle to the enemies of the Légion du Seuil.

Data:Acted.chaima.stalk.edge.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.stalk.edge.json.desc: Lalla Chaima left for Budapest to follow and watch Medusa - having first established at Hush House that she should, above all, not get too close.

Data:Acted.chaima.stalk.rose.json.label: Acted: Chaima
Data:Acted.chaima.stalk.rose.json.desc: Lalla Chaima left for Budapest to follow and watch Medusa - having first established at Hush House that she should, above all, show respect.

Data:Acted.connie.box.moon.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.box.moon.json.desc: MCO Lee suspected St Mihail's Coffin might contain a name of the Chandler... perhaps, she said, the second one she'd heard mentioned that year. She was clearly perturbed by the possibility.

Data:Acted.connie.mob.moon.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.mob.moon.json.desc: MCO Lee, greatly concerned that a Reckoner might somehow have found a way to cheat the Madrugad, left for Kaunas in a hurry.

Data:Acted.connie.observe.scaly.sky.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.observe.scaly.sky.json.desc: MCO Lee, concerned by the call of the West, decided not to go there in person - instead resolving that the Bureau should do what it could to keep the coasts safe.
